verdicts.reason: A reads left to right (logo and can, then headline and body, then CTA and Sunset Sale), and the can keeps a readable size. However, the three badges sit in an uneven staggered stack (Limited Edition alone, the other two offset below it), the missing-asset placeholder box is left showing on the right, and the fine print sits tight against the bottom edge. B shrinks the hero can to a thumbnail at the top, and the Sunset Sale sticker is wedged into the badge row so it fights the pills for attention. The body copy, CTA and tiny legal text are crammed into the right column next to the placeholder box, so the oversized headline is the only thing with any presence.
